description: Marketplace escrow: an agent buys from a seller. Every outcome is signed live: no pre-signed transactions and no Tickets. The policy co-signer keeps the shipBy and inspectBy timers; when one expires it emits a signed timeout notice, and the arbiter signs the default live with the winning party (refund if no carrier-attested shipment by shipBy; release after inspectBy if shipped and undisputed). Disputes are ruled live (full refund or full release) by an accredited arbiter, bond to the winner. No arbiter-silent defaults; the ruling deadline only raises an ops alert, which repeats until the account closes.

release.confirm.description: The buyer confirms receipt: the seller is paid the price less the fee; anything extra goes back to the buyer.

refund.agreed.description: Buyer and seller cancel (for example before shipping): everything goes back to the buyer.

dispute.refund.description: The arbiter rules for the buyer and signs with the buyer: everything, bond included, back to the buyer. The co-signer is not involved.

dispute.release.description: The arbiter rules for the seller and signs with the seller: the price less the fee, plus the dispute bond (bond to the winner), to the seller. The co-signer is not involved.

default.refund.description: The seller never recorded a shipment by shipBy. The co-signer emits a signed timeout notice; on request it builds a short-lived proposal that the buyer signs first, then the arbiter verifies independently, signs and submits: the whole balance (a sweep) goes back to the buyer. Option (a): either party can be the second signer.

default.release.description: Shipped, and nobody disputed by inspectBy. The co-signer emits a signed timeout notice; on request it builds a short-lived proposal that the seller signs first, then the arbiter verifies independently, signs and submits: the seller is paid the price less the fee, and anything extra is swept back to the buyer. Option (a): either party can be the second signer.

shipBy.description: Fixed at open and kept by the co-signer: the named carrier attester must record the shipment (shipping.shipped/1) by this time. At expiry with no shipment, the co-signer emits a signed timeout notice for default.refund (signed live by the arbiter and the buyer).

inspectBy.description: Fixed at open and kept by the co-signer: the buyer must dispute by this time. At expiry, a recorded shipment with no open dispute makes the co-signer emit a signed timeout notice for default.release (signed live by the arbiter and the seller). An open dispute blocks it.

rulingDueBy.description: Arbiter SLA for ruling on an open dispute. Expiry raises a RULING_OVERDUE ops alert that repeats until the account is deleted; it moves no money, and a later ruling is still accepted (dispute.lateRuling = accept).
